title: Points to Watch in Practicing the Way - Part 3
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
series: Points to Watch in Practicing the Way
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett's talk emphasizes the importance of confronting painful histories and acknowledging one's own privilege and responsibility as a Bodhisattva practitioner. This involves learning from and listening to marginalized voices, rather than seeking personal gain or recognition. By doing so, we can cultivate compassion, trust, and understanding, creating space for others to find their own healing and depth.
